note: Server database; optimistic revision checks prevent silent overwrites. Polls for updates every 15 seconds.
Platform sign-in plus server-side project membership. Site sharing must be configured separately.
Editable category/code hierarchies, drag ordering and accessible order controls, archive/restore and merge reference integrity.

feature: Precise text coding and coder attribution
note: Codepoint anchors with exact quotation validation. Each researcher creates an independent coding record.
Preserve prior text. Shift unchanged anchors and flag ranges touching an edit; conservative for multiple edits.

Shared project/source/code/case/passage memos, journals and private account notes. Explicit Unicode-safe record-ID mentions and picker/clickable previews preserve linkage across renames; unavailable/deleted/hidden links do not redirect by name. Native snapshots retain metadata; REFI standard-only exports carry text with disclosed link losses.

Whole-source and exact passage-level case assignments, typed text/number/boolean/date source/case forms, previewed CSV/XLSX case tables, numeric/date analysis filters and case-attribute matrices. Imported originals preserved.

Direct/subtree/category/all-code rows across sources, cases and case attributes; applications/excerpts/union codepoints/current-recording seconds/rectangle area. Normalized text coverage and applications per 1,000 eligible codepoints include restricted and case-passage denominators, exact drilldowns and CSV/SVG export. Shared parent/case evidence is nonadditive.

Separate original-application and interval-result modes. Unicode text intersection, connected union, subtraction and NEAR; same-recording seconds; current revision/consent scope, uncoded literal search and provenance-checked saved/frozen fragments. Geometry algebra remains separate.

Exact/overlap/contains/touch/near/same-source relations with evidence and GraphML, plus editable saved researcher concept maps. New selected-pair exports give distances and overlap/union lengths; overlapping text decomposes before/shared/after with source/revision identity. Recording seconds stay separate. No distance boxplots/significance tests.

Clickable word/theme counts, source/speaker shares, turn sequence and evidence-linked visualizations. English/French/Spanish/custom stop lists, Unicode concordance and 1–3 word phrases. Whole-source vocabulary uses source/case and typed attribute scope; code/coder/decision filters govern coding evidence separately.

Text exact-span sets, union Jaccard, eligible-corpus kappa and evidence-linked coder-overlap heatmap preserve source/code dimensions. Recording-second Jaccard and image/PDF union IoU remain separate. Blind coders receive their own layers; reviewers compare full state. Agent identities do not establish independent human reliability or consensus.

Accept/flag reviews, soft-remove/restore, original coder layers and separate consensus. Atomic operation history adds target/quotation filters and bounded field-level before/after values with revision metadata; blind histories omit raw payloads and deny hidden-text filters.
Per-coder substantive ranges checked for one evidence and one stance; flags do not rewrite imported decisions.
Not asked, no evidence, expertise boundary and follow-up states are recorded separately from coding.
Value, units, basis, assumptions, verification and CSV; imported flags remain pending without rows.

Preview/cancel plus strict required-table/column validation. Supported original rows, attribute definitions, journals, important markers and inert SQL queries retain provenance. Earlier adapter/runtime sample scopes are documented in the public import audit; ancillary tables and unavailable media paths are not fully activated.

Browser-local TXT/Markdown encoding chooser, HTML, ODT, EPUB, RTF, DOCX, pasted text, timestamped JSON/SRT/VTT. Exact canonical text, extraction-loss warnings, original-byte SHA256 provenance, RTL/auto direction and supplied turn times retained.

feature: Text PDF import and original view
note: Text extraction, original PDF page rendering, region coding and PDFSource/PDFSelection exchange. Optional genuine browser-local English OCR previews scanned PDFs, up to 12 pages/16MiB/12MP; warnings and confidence require correction. Exact text and source provenance retained.
Normalized rectangles and retrieval overlays; actual QualCoder import preserves pixel geometry, authors and descriptions. Native and standard-only media exchange tested.

Private multipart upload, byte-range playback, fractional recording ranges, timestamp links and media exchange. Browser waveform preview remains bounded to40MB; actual long-recording model quality and externally generated long waveforms remain unverified.

Durable jobs, bounded full-recording decoding, authenticated uploads/playback, cancel/retry and reviewed application. WhisperX remains default; optional faster-whisper CPU backend preserves native word times/probabilities without forced alignment or diarization. Hosted use needs reachable configured worker/models. Local runtime evidence is documented separately; accuracy remains unverified.

Recording/source/run-bound regular and separately supplied exclusive tracks, overlap timeline, count hints, corrections/history, RTTM and subtitles. One global diarizer precedes absolute-time chunk assignment. Real pyannote models/accuracy unverified. Pinned WhisperX wrapper drops exclusive model output; direct adapter needed. No verified speaker identities are inferred.

Eligible corpus paragraphs, definitions/examples, paged budgets/provider finish, exact current quote and consent checks. New candidates overlapping current same-code applications are suppressed with a count; stale/deleted decisions do not block them. Live provider quality unverified. Deterministic literal/restricted-regex preview and own-run undo operate without a model.

Persistent cosine index, paragraph/speaker-line or fixed-window modes, Unicode anchors, source exclusions, content/revision/chunk-mode cache partitioning and stoppable multi-batch indexing. Fixture tests pass; real provider/model quality remains unverified.

Grounded summary/definition/consistency/hierarchy drafts, explicit all/accepted scope, sampled coverage, configured context/response budgets and provider finish metadata. Adaptive outliers may return none. Truncated replies rejected; decisions/citations rechecked. Actual service inference/model accuracy remains unverified.

Native JSON and scoped CSV/XLSX/HTML/Markdown/ODT reports, SVG/GraphML, matrices, relation evidence and word tables retain explicit scope/units/provenance. Annotated-source HTML/DOCX redacts restricted passages; native snapshots preserve original data. IRaMuTeQ text plus manifest requires receiving-app verification.

Actual QualCoder importer preserves category, nested codes, definitions and colours in synthetic fixture. AQDA expects native SQLite; Taguette uses a separate path/definition CSV export. No claim that those apps accept QDC.

Typed zero, false, date and fractional number variables schema-valid, imported by actual QualCoder and reimported in the browser without native sidecars. Native sidecar retains passage cases, pins/links, review/query provenance and timing/history with explicit loss report. QualCoder SourceRef case-link loss and unverified Sift runtime remain limitations.

Checksum-verified revisioned recovery and native project ZIP with optional current/historical recordings/images/PDFs, transcript JSON/text, timing, coding, review, framework/consent state and available server metadata. Transcript-only ZIP preserves references without bytes. Media import remaps exact uploaded bytes; metadata does not recreate grants/jobs. Memory-based ZIP, not streaming or offsite infrastructure backup.

Keyboard forms, responsive panels and named controls. Dialogs focus on open, wrap Tab/Shift+Tab, close with Escape and restore focus. Browser rehearsal validates this flow; formal accessibility and cross-browser certification remain pending.

Owner-restricted examples preserve source wording and stored labels with provisional coding, guided reading and evidence-linked visuals. Identity, speaker accuracy, reviewed human coding and inference are not invented. Sources excluded from AI remain excluded; examples do not establish research findings.

Agent-prepared or manual recommendations stay separate from researcher coding. Exact context/counterpoints, accept/revise/reject/defer, reasons, re-anchoring, evidence snapshots, optional researcher coding and durable ledger. Agent review is identified explicitly and does not establish human agreement.

Preview/cancel project and source imports, explicit protocol/source role, supported QualCoder provenance and attribute definitions/important flags/inert queries. Three NHHR stages are one interview. Six same-text broad-to-claim windows drill down to preserved originals.

feature: Saved queries and explicit reading progress
note: Named dynamic code/source/coder/status/text/NEAR specifications persist. Read-range markers and resume stay separate from coding coverage; transcript edits invalidate affected markers.

feature: Labelled coding range overview and source sequence
note: Exact range overview, source sequence and geometric transcript-side stripes with resize tracking; up to eight shared color lanes, every decision accessible through the range overview. Real browser-local audio waveform/range coding added with a 40 MB preview limit. Longer waveform generation requires external processing.

feature: Grouped and stacked analysis charts; code hierarchy
note: Scoped bars/heatmap matrix, multi-source text coding portrait, measure-weighted sunburst/treemap (applications,codepoints,seconds,area), SVG/XLSX and evidence drilldowns. Summed code allocation and deduplicated scope totals are explicitly separate; counts are not prevalence.
Unicode anchors, English/French/Spanish/custom/no stop list, 1–3 word phrases, frequency CSV and linked concordance. Consent-review passages withheld; vocabulary uses explicit whole-source scope.

Owner-managed role capabilities and manual/focused presets; server blind-coding projection for state,AI,exports and actor-only minimal audit. Authenticated private notes; permission-safe recovery. Shared-source metadata remains visible. Presence/cursor synchronization and formal independent-coding certification are not claimed.

feature: Advanced source ingestion and long audio
note: Local HTML/ODT/EPUB/RTF, encodings,paste,RTL and genuine English image/PDF OCR with original-byte/loss provenance. Multi-part long transcription with single global recording diarizer and resource gates implemented in separate worker; actual model execution remains connection required.

feature: Previewed CSV / QDC / JSON codebook import
note: Previewed atomic CSV/QDC/JSON codebooks with explicit CSV hierarchy; schema-detected AQDA/Taguette/QualCoder SQLite import. Active exact anchors and attribution retained; uncertain anchors quarantined, credentials/permissions omitted. AQDA/Taguette native imports are one-way; outward exchange uses REFI with field-loss notes.

Reusable existing-code selections filter analysis/reports. Portable JSON/QDC collections include required non-codable category/code ancestors, preview/reimport with fresh IDs, and omit source/coding/notes/configuration. Own-set/blind permissions enforced.

reference: AQDA, Taguette, QualCoder, Sift, OpenQDA, Requal/RQDA, WhisperX, pyannote.audio
note: Committed sample projects and exact upstream-generated fixtures were imported with original-byte hashes. Native Requal, SQLite UTF8/UTF16/BOM preservation, QDC envelopes, explicit case-column mapping and STM/TSV units are tested. See public example import tests for sample-specific limits; native Sift uses QDPX and no real inference is claimed.

feature: Framework Method charting and critical review
note: Research question, working themes and method-stage progress; source-by-theme summaries with exact supporting/contrasting evidence, qualifications, observed/not-observed/withheld states, version/review history and CSV/HTML reports. Source rows are not verified participant identities. Changed/restricted evidence withholds the interpretation until reviewed.

feature: Passage consent scopes and authorization history
note: Candidate off-record/nonattribution phrases prompt exact-scope reviewer decisions: pending, included or withheld, with reasoning and history. Included scope enters analysis; edits across it suspend authorization. Detection does not infer a return on record or grant consent. Native archives retain original source/history; they are not redacted sharing packages.

Complete current source text with overlap references and exact coding ledger, researcher/layer filters, attribution and scope metadata. Restricted text becomes placeholders; intersecting/stale/media/deleted coding and private notes/rationales/versions/attributes are omitted. Word OOXML tested through independent reader; HTML prints to PDF. Direct PDF/RTF generation absent.

Source review shows native ASR probability histogram and adjustable flagged-turn threshold with passage navigation and recording-bound listening. Alignment scores are labelled separately, missing values stay unknown and stale anchors are excluded. Review priorities are not calibrated transcription-error estimates.

Accepted parent-code evidence seeds model drafts with editable names/definitions and unchecked selections. Reviewer-created codes revalidate current exact evidence, parent membership, definition provenance, consent and normalized sibling names. Existing coding is not reassigned. Synthetic provider contracts pass; live model quality unverified.

feature: Live team presence and cursor synchronization
note: Shared project revisions poll every 15 seconds and stale writes are rejected. Live authenticated presence/navigation broadcasts and simultaneous rich-text cursor/edit synchronization remain infrastructure work; polling is not equivalent.
Native snapshots and revisioned web recovery do not reconcile independently edited offline branches. No automatic offline merge or outward AQDA-native exporter is claimed.
